patch.value: Support relative local packages with compiler-owned identities

Follow-up to PR 154. A Program can resolve a relative declaration import without packageId even when it crosses a nested local package boundary. The checker now inventories manifest locations during copying, without reading names, and returns unsupported_project_shape for a loaded unknown boundary unless the compiler identifies the package or the solution includes its project config. This avoids synthetic resolution and metadata ancestry. Broader relative-package support needs a compiler-owned identity contract; ordinary local declarations, unused metadata, installed dependencies and referenced projects remain supported.

Obtain ownership from actual Program resolution data without synthetic imports or package metadata ancestry; retain current typed refusal until identity is available; preserve direct compiler diagnostics and exact installed layouts; include named, unnamed, nested and mts/cts/ts package fixtures
